format: data/body values are type descriptors; numeric literals are fixed values. request_type and builder are documentation metadata, not wire fields. Empty objects are fixed empty objects. Array templates show one element; notes describe known counts.

transport.master_loads: POST /Dragon/game; same load constructor at 0x140048d40, caller 0x140109ac0

scalar_types.integer: JSON integer array element; input width not asserted
scalar_types.int32(-1) or uint64: Signed -1 for locked cells; unsigned 64-bit nonnegative cell values.

example_warning: Companion requests use synthetic values and placeholders; they are shapes, not live credentials or promises that all-zero IDs will be accepted.
source: Original binary matched by SHA-256; constructor string xrefs, JSON node tags, primitive writers and manual nesting review. No runtime logs, credentials or profiles read. This is static reconstruction, not an original server specification.

generic_forwarder.input: Caller-provided raw JSON and a request-type selector; no fixed call name.
generic_forwarder.limitation: A finite constructor list cannot enumerate arbitrary script-supplied JSON. This is not a claim to recover the retired server implementation or every possible dynamic call.

response_contracts: Response contracts are excluded from these request-only files. ROI-Client-API.json pairs the native requests with current revival response examples and explicitly unknown original contracts.
enum_semantics: Numeric enum values, optionality and original server validation are left unspecified unless a note gives a directly checked mapping.
